faq.q: What is AI customer service for retail and e-commerce?
faq.a: It is software that answers your store's chats automatically. Cekat.AI replies to product, stock, price, and delivery questions instantly on WhatsApp, Instagram, and web chat, 24/7, in natural language, and can process the order inside the conversation, from shipping cost to payment QR.

faq.q: Can the AI actually process orders in the chat?
faq.a: Yes. Cekat.AI auto-creates orders from the conversation, including shipping cost, payment, and customer details. The agent can check ongkir through API integration and send a payment QR, so a buyer goes from question to paid order without ever leaving the chat.

faq.q: How does abandoned checkout recovery work?
faq.a: Cekat.AI sends automatic reminders based on each customer's behavior, payment still pending, promo about to end, time to replenish. Follow-up nudges go out through the official WhatsApp API at the right moment, so unfinished checkouts turn into completed orders without your team chasing anyone manually.

faq.q: Which channels can my store connect?
faq.a: WhatsApp (official Business API), Instagram DM, Facebook Messenger, website live chat, and API channels, all flowing into one unified inbox. Every buyer keeps a single conversation history, so no order or question falls between channels.

faq.q: Can I send promo broadcasts to my customers?
faq.a: Yes. Broadcast campaigns are sent through the official WhatsApp Business API to segments built from activity, purchase history, or events, new buyers, loyal customers, ghosting leads. Messages pull names and context from the CRM, and results are tracked down to replies and revenue.

faq.q: How does the AI learn my product catalog?
faq.a: You paste your product information, prices, and SOPs into the knowledge base, no coding required. Building the agent takes around five minutes and works like briefing a new CS admin; from then on it answers from your actual catalog, not guesses.

faq.q: What happens during a flash sale or a sudden chat surge?
faq.a: The AI answers every incoming chat instantly, no matter how many arrive at once, so response time stays flat when volume spikes. Anything complex escalates to your team with the full conversation attached, and AI working hours keep coverage running after your admins log off.

faq.q: Will customers notice they are chatting with AI?
faq.a: Cekat.AI's agent is humanlike, it understands intent and context rather than matching keywords, replies in natural language, and handles multiple languages. When a conversation needs a person, it hands off to your team automatically with the full history, so the customer never repeats themselves.

faq.q: Can I see which campaigns actually make money?
faq.a: Yes. The analytics dashboard tracks ad spend, ROAS, cost, revenue, and customer progression in one place, and CAPI integration with Meta and TikTok feeds better signal quality back to your ads, so budget follows the campaigns that convert, not the ones that just deliver.
